mechanics.original_reminder: Exile the top three cards of your library face up. Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to an opponent, put a journeyed card you own into your hand.
mechanics.executable_reminder: Exile the top card of your library face up. Give it the journeyed status while in exile. Register a persistent rule named "journey retrieval" for you with event condition "You own a card in exile with the journeyed status" and ability "Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to an opponent, put a card you own in exile with the journeyed status into your hand."

rule_text.name: 701.79a
rule_text.rule: Journey is a keyword action. To journey, exile the top card of your library face up and it becomes journeyed.

rule_text.name: 701.79b
rule_text.rule: There is an inherent triggered ability associated with owning journeyed cards in exile. This triggered ability has no source and is controlled by the player whose creature triggered it. The full text of this ability is “Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to an opponent, put a journeyed card you own from exile into your hand.”

rule_text.name: 701.79c
rule_text.rule: The triggered ability will trigger once for each creature that dealt combat damage, regardless of how many journeyed cards that player owns in exile.

mechanics.semantic_equivalence: MSEM701.79a-c: exile-incarnation designation and one source-free player rule, ownership gates event capture only; no new resolution-time intervening condition. Formal opponent restriction governs the older a-player printed reminder; complete original source remains preserved.

subrules.name: 702.216a
subrules.rule: Cybersoul is an activated ability. “Cybersoul [Cost]” means “[Cost]: Transform this permanent. For each generic mana in this ability's total cost, you may tap an untapped artifact you control rather than pay that mana. Activate only as a sorcery.”

subrules.name: 702.224a
subrules.rule: Decoy is a triggered ability that creates a delayed triggered ability. “Decoy” means “Whenever this creature attacks, create a tapped and attacking token that’s a copy of it, except it's a 1/1 Illusion instead of its other creature types.” and “Exile that token at the beginning of the next end step.”

subrules.name: 702.224b
subrules.rule: If a creature has multiple instances of decoy, each triggers separately.

subrules.name: 702.224c
subrules.rule: If a replacement effect causes the decoy ability to create multiple tokens, they will be exiled by the delayed trigger as well.

subrules.name: 701.70a
subrules.rule: “Journey” means “Exile the top card of your library. That card becomes journeyed.”

subrules.name: 701.70b
subrules.rule: There is an inherent triggered ability associated with journeying. The full text of this ability is “Whenever a creature deals combat damage to one of its controller's opponents, if its controller owns any journeyed cards, the creature's controller puts a journeyed card they own into their hand.” This ability has no source and is controlled by the controller of the creature which dealt the damage that caused it to trigger. This is an exception to rule 113.8.

subrules.name: 701.70c
subrules.rule: Journeyed is a designation that has no rules meaning other than to act as a marker that the inherent triggered ability and other spells and abilities can identify. Only cards in exile can gain or have this designation. Once a card becomes journeyed, it stays journeyed until it leaves exile or becomes a new object (see rule 406.7). Journeyed is neither an ability nor part of the card's copiable values.

mechanics.original_reminder: Exile the top three cards of your library face up. Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to an opponent, put a journeyed card you own into your hand.
mechanics.executable_reminder: Exile the top card of your library face up. Give it the journeyed status while in exile. Register a persistent rule named "journey retrieval" for you with condition "You own a card in exile with the journeyed status" and ability "Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to an opponent, put a card you own in exile with the journeyed status into your hand."
mechanics.semantic_equivalence: Exact exile-incarnation status plus one persistent source-free player rule; singular creature combat trigger and REV intervening ownership check. Parent strict/native/full-source verification required.

subrules.rule: Rapture is a triggered ability. "Rapture" means "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield with a haze counter on it. As long as it has a haze counter on it, it loses all abilities and can't block."

mechanics.original_reminder: When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield with a haze counter on it. It loses all abilities and can't block.

semantic_equivalence.evidence: Rule rapture ties both ability removal and blocking restriction to the returned object retaining a haze counter; unlike the abbreviated source reminder, removing all haze counters ends both restrictions.

rule_text.name: 702.275a
rule_text.rule: Chronicle is a static ability found on chronicle cards. “Chronicle” means “As this permanent enters the battlefield, put a lore counter on it,” and “As your precombat main phase begins, put a lore counter on this permanent unless it has a number of lore counters greater than or equal to its final chapter number.” The latter is a turn-based action and does not use the stack.

mechanics.semantic_equivalence: Formal702.275a: ordinary enters-with lore replacement plus declared native no-stack precombat lore action stopping at current final chapter. Chronicle identity remains custom keyword identity; no Saga type or Saga sacrifice introduced.
